title: Clam Soup

difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 2 kg clams
- 200 g tomato
- 1 garlic clove
- 2 tablespoons parsley
- 2 slices country bread
- 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Put the clams to purge in salted water for 2 hours.
2. Blanch the tomatoes, drain them, peel them, remove the seeds and chop them.
3. Drain the clams, collect them in a pot, cover and let them open; filter the liquid that has formed and shell them.
4. Peel the garlic and let it wilt in a pot with 2 tablespoons of oil; after 4 minutes remove it, pour the tomato into the container and after 5 minutes the clam liquid and a ladle of water; after 3-4 minutes the clams and the parsley.
5. Meanwhile, cut the bread into cubes and brown them in a pan with the remaining oil.
6. Mix the soup and distribute it among the plates; sprinkle the croutons on top and serve.
